name: Azure Pipelines
summary: Azure Pipelines is the CI/CD part of Azure DevOps. Each organization with billing set up gets one free Microsoft-hosted parallel job with 1,800 minutes a month and one free self-hosted job. Extra parallel jobs cost $40 for Microsoft-hosted and $15 for self-hosted.

facts.text: The free tier for private projects is one parallel job of up to 60 minutes per run, 1,800 minutes a month, and it applies only after billing is set up with a valid Azure subscription.
Paid parallel jobs can run up to 360 minutes and have no monthly time limit.
Public projects are retired. New ones cannot be created, and existing ones keep their free grants until they convert to private in 2027.
A pipeline stage can require a manual approval check on an environment, or use trigger: manual so a production stage waits for a person.
Logs for each step can be viewed in the run results, and all logs for a run can be downloaded.
Microsoft says the prices are estimates, may vary with the type of agreement, and are calculated in US dollars.

plans.name: Free parallel jobs
plans.notes: 1 Microsoft-hosted job with 1,800 minutes and 1 self-hosted job with unlimited minutes

hiddenCosts: The free grant needs billing set up with a valid Azure subscription.
